description: Approve filing one of your cases, when your company requires approval (set_approval_required). The approval is for one draft: draft_id is the draft you showed the person (get_case's draft.draft_id). If the case has a newer draft by then, nothing is approved (draft_changed): show the person the newer draft and approve it only once they have read it. For a Harmful or illegal case that may be reported as Defamation, accusation_untrue.attested_by states, with the approval, that the accusation in the highlighted words is untrue and names the person at your company who says so: a Defamation report is never filed without that statement. (capability: cases.approve_own)
name: approve_filing
